support.summary: This is the current coordinated Contract Registry release; Phase 31 defines accessibility standards, metadata and portal audit evidence, not universal accessibility certification of every future runtime product.

recommendedAction: New and changed NEXT F interfaces should resolve and apply the relevant accessibility controls, run available automated checks, and explicitly record required manual review. Existing Sites remain pinned until explicit validation and upgrade review.
